Radiant Heating

Ductless Mini-Splits

Heating Maintenance

Furnaces

AC Repair in the Tri-Cities

Fast, honest, and reliable AC repair for homes in Johnson City, Kingsport, Bristol, Blountville, and nearby communities.

40+ Years of Combined Experience · Up-Front Pricing · 100% Satisfaction Guarantee · One-Year Warranty on All Services

Request AC Repair Service

AC Acting Up? Let’s Get Your Cool Back

When your AC stops cooling, you do not want vague answers, surprise costs, or a temporary fix that misses the real problem. You want clear diagnostics, honest recommendations, and reliable repair from a team that understands Tri-Cities homes.

Air Comfort Services provides AC repair across Johnson City, Kingsport, Bristol, Blountville, Gray, Jonesborough, Church Hill, Piney Flats, and nearby communities. Whether your system is blowing warm air, leaking water, short cycling, making strange noises, or failing during peak heat, our technicians look at the full system before recommending a repair.

With more than 2 decades of combined HVAC experience, we explain what is happening, what it means, and what your options are. No hidden fees. No scare tactics. Just clear answers and up-front pricing.

Get a Free Estimate

What Your AC Problem Might Mean

Tri-Cities summers bring heat, humidity, and long cooling cycles. That combination can reveal small AC problems fast, especially in older homes, homes with aging ductwork, or systems that have skipped maintenance. These common warning signs can help you know when to schedule service:

Homeowners call Air Comfort Services for issues like:

  • Warm air from vents — may point to low refrigerant, a frozen coil, thermostat trouble, or compressor issues
  • Weak airflow — a dirty filter, blower problem, duct restriction, or frozen coil could be limiting circulation
  • Water near the indoor unit — often caused by a clogged drain line, frozen coil, or drainage issue
  • Breaker keeps tripping — can signal a failing component or overloaded system
  • AC runs constantly — may mean poor efficiency, restricted airflow, low refrigerant, or aging equipment
  • Short cycling, unusual noises, or high energy bills

If something feels off, it is better to have it checked early than wait for the next heat wave to make the problem worse.

Join the Comfort Club

Why Tri-Cities Homeowners Choose Air Comfort Services

When your AC breaks down, you deserve more than a quick fix. You deserve a team that explains the issue, respects your home, and helps you avoid repeat problems.

40+ Years of Combined Experience
Our local technicians have seen a wide range of AC issues across Tri-Cities homes and know how to diagnose them correctly.

Up-Front Pricing
No hidden fees and no surprises. You know what to expect before work begins.

100% Satisfaction Guarantee
Every AC repair is backed by our satisfaction guarantee.

One-Year Warranty on All Services
We stand behind the work we perform.

Priority Scheduling for Comfort Club Members
Comfort Club members receive priority scheduling, routine maintenance, and exclusive discounts.

Flexible Financing Options
Financing options are available to help make services more manageable.

Join the Comfort Club

Our AC Repair Services

Air Comfort Services repairs central air conditioners, heat pumps, and ductless mini-splits throughout the Tri-Cities.

Central AC Repair

Central AC systems rely on proper airflow, refrigerant levels, electrical components, and clean coils to cool your home. If one part is not working correctly, comfort can drop quickly.

  • Warm air from vents
  • Frozen coils
  • Refrigerant leaks
  • Compressor issues
  • Electrical problems
  • Weak airflow
  • Drain line clogs
  • Thermostat problems

Heat Pump Repair

Heat pumps are common in Northeast Tennessee because they provide both heating and cooling. That means they work hard through both summer cooling and winter heating seasons.

  • Poor cooling performance
  • Frozen outdoor units
  • Refrigerant problems
  • Short cycling
  • Unusual noises
  • Weak airflow
  • System not switching modes correctly

Ductless Mini-Split Repair

Ductless systems are great for targeted comfort, especially in additions, bonus rooms, garages, finished basements, and spaces that never seem to stay comfortable.

  • Poor cooling in one zone
  • Water leaks
  • Drainage issues
  • Dirty or clogged filters
  • Refrigerant leaks
  • Electrical or communication errors
  • Indoor unit airflow issues

What to Expect During Your AC Repair Visit

AC problems are stressful enough. The repair process should not be. Here is what you can expect when you schedule service with Air Comfort Services:

  1. We listen to what you’re noticing
    Tell us whether your AC is blowing warm air, running nonstop, leaking water, making noise, or cooling unevenly.
  2. We inspect the system
    Our technician checks key components like airflow, thermostat operation, refrigerant levels, electrical connections, coils, drain lines, and overall system performance.
  3. We explain the problem clearly
    You will know what is wrong, why it matters, and what options are available.
  1. You receive up-front pricing
    We explain the repair scope before work begins, with no hidden fees.
  2. We complete the repair and test the system
    Once the repair is complete, we test operation so your system is ready to cool your home properly.

Prevent Future Breakdowns With Comfort Club

You may want to consider AC replacement if:

  • Some rooms stay warmer than others
  • Energy bills keep rising
